scientific_scope.primary_claim_if_successful: expanded explicit-task contrastive SFT improves raw candidate-level de-novo and edit results

data_contract.heldout_isolation: canonical source and target hashes against eval_balanced and available frozen P19/P20 references

amendment_before_training.trigger: first data-only manifest showed approximately 200 exact edit programs and only about 16 rows per paper task
amendment_before_training.change: reserve 60 percent of edit rows for the ten Table2 task families, matching a family when its required clauses are a subset of the explicit program

aligned_24k_amendment_before_training.trigger: completed 6k manifest showed only six of ten paper buckets and extremely sparse exact programs despite the subset-matching reserve
aligned_24k_amendment_before_training.change: replace the 7200-row paper reserve with ten exact 720-row task quotas projected from train-only source-target pairs that pass every requested benchmark direction; keep 4800 explicit-instruction broad edit rows

denovo_pool_repair_before_training.trigger: strict frozen-reference exclusion removed one 2p row from the otherwise exact 12000-row de-novo pool
denovo_pool_repair_before_training.change: append one seeded leakage-free donor from the same train-candidate molecular pool and project its seven declared numeric targets to an exact MW+QED 2p program
denovo_pool_repair_before_training.resulting_quota_target: 2000 rows for each property count 2p through 7p

evaluation_contract.table1_de_novo: strict success by 2p-7p property count plus validity
evaluation_contract.table2_edit: candidate-level validity, strict property success, and Tanimoto>=0.65
